VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)
